title: One fix loop run (contract agent-run v1, Phase 4, D347, D349)
description: One record per `stangent fix` run of a ticket: the branch, the base, the settings, each step's turns and cost, each check's result with its output file, and why it stopped. Written by `stangent fix report` to .stangent/fix/<KEY>/agent-run.json; the run's telemetry event is written from it (D21).

base.description: The ref the branch started from, as given.

worktree.description: Relative to the repo; null when none was made.

context.description: What the fixer was given (D345): ticket = the ticket, the code and the failing test; bundle = the same plus the ticket bundle; null before prepare.

steps.description: The proof (already paid, counted toward the ticket's cap, D348) and each fixer call.

turns.description: The model's rounds; null for the proof, whose record doesn't keep them.

ended.description: Claude Code's result subtype: success, error_max_turns, error_max_budget_usd, …

result.description: not-checked: code couldn't tell (a graph that couldn't be rebuilt), never a pass.

output.description: The check's full output, relative to the repo.

plan.description: task-plan.json, relative to the repo; null when no plan was checked.

outsideReach.description: Edited files in neither the plan's changes nor their reach (D344).

edited.description: Files the fixer edited on the branch (the proof test left out).

costUsd.description: The ticket's whole cost: the proof's and every fixer call's.
